sweep.method: All original indexed triangles at interval midpoints. Base and wheel continuous interval AABBs use frozen R02 analytic vertex speed bounds; valve continuous AABBs use the adapter’s fixed-length-chain whole-revolution reachable bounds. Static and per-phase BVHs cache complete exact triangles. No fitted or sampled velocity bound is used.
sweep.sampledPairTermination: Narrow phase stops after the first genuine surface witness for a pair; the original six pairs are separately screened over every midpoint. Disjoint exact full-vertex AABBs safely prune triangle checks.
sweep.geometrySource: 338 inherited names exactly once, with explicitly declared same-name valve replacements; all 16 supplemental components, six full native wheel instances, full default locomotive shell; no mesh decimation

limitations: No-witness continuous broad-phase candidates remain unresolved.
Dense midpoint triangle checks are not a continuous triangle time-of-impact proof.
Only retained-static versus retained-static pairs are excluded; added or replaced static valve parts are tested against every static body.
Within-one-rigid-body self-intersections and full solid containment are not tested.
Only declared rigid assembly pairs are exempted. Working pin/eye, finite die/slot and body/guide pairs remain in the screen.
Inside motion, Gresley coupling, steam ports, lap/lead, admission, forces, elasticity, manufacture and historical A4 timing remain unverified.
